_about: The poses of a talking-head character. Make each image with any image model (ChatGPT, Gemini, …): first `base` with a photo of the person attached, then one message per pose = `template` with {pose} filled in. Save as <character>/raw/<name>.png, then: node scripts/poses.mjs <character>. `use` says when a pose fits a line (timeline "pose": "<name>"). Only idle is required; delete or add poses freely (a character folder may carry its own poses.json).
base: Draw the person in the attached photo as a flat 2D cartoon character: flat solid skin colour with very little shading, bold clean dark outlines, simple big expressive eyes with clear white eye-whites, and a thick white sticker outline around the whole character. Keep their likeness (hair, face shape, glasses if any). If they have a beard or moustache, keep it thin and leave CLEAR SKIN all around the lips so the mouth is fully visible; lips in a pink or warm-red tone. A plain top in one solid colour. Head and shoulders down to mid-chest, facing the camera, mouth CLOSED in a relaxed slight smile. Plain flat light-grey background, no text, no props. Portrait 4:5.
template: Same character, exactly the same art style, size, framing, outfit and plain light-grey background as your last images. Mouth closed with lips together (I animate the mouth separately). Hands at chest height or higher and fully inside the frame. One image only. Pose: {pose}

poses.name: idle
poses.pose: relaxed, arms down, friendly slight smile, looking straight at the camera
poses.use: default; neutral narration; anything without a stronger feeling
